body: Is there a bug report open for this?

> Is there a bug report open for this?

No, I'm sorry, I didn't open a bug report for this issue. I was just accidentally developing my own plugin for importing blockbench models (JSON .bbmodel-files) and thought the editor was crashing due to regenerating a large number of meshes and some conflicts with the render server. But it turned out to be a tab index issue!)))
There might already be an open issue for this (and even an open fix) so it'd be good to have some context at least
Please forgive me again, I will now try to find reports related to this problem.
No worries! Thank you for looking!

Related reports:
- #100484 (same crash, different repro)
- #84522 (same root cause, different variant).
Both were closed without addressing the underlying issue of stale indices in `edited_scene`. This PR fixes the root cause by using stable path-based lookup instead of indices across the reload cycle.
Noting that #121664 seems to be the same issue. I've run into similar with a custom scene importer, and this PR fixes the problem.

I tested the code using the MRP from #121664, and while it fixes the import crash, it now emits this error multiple times instead:
```
ERROR: Index p_idx = 1 is out of bounds (edited_scene.size() = 1).
```

> The old scene tab is removed before the new one is added — a confirmation
dialog ("Open Anyway?") may appear in between — making the stored index stale.

This was wrong behavior. The dialog should never appear when reloading the scene, because it makes no sense. #123301 fixed this, so closing. Thanks for the contribution.
